notes.method: Christian Quarter Rd souq profile by hand (the street is layer -1 in OSM, so make_spec's SOUQ_STREETS profile never reaches it; see the profile requests): closed dukkan openings ~2.0-2.6 x 2.8-3.2 m between rough piers, teal panelled steel doors with padlock bars, a few olive and green roll-down shutters, raised thresholds, timber/steel shed canopies at 2.9-3.6 m on green hoop brackets projecting 1.3 m (street 4-5 m wall to wall). Notes 1.2; B03, B05 (all shops closed), B06. Upper floors left to the rules. Edge 2 faces north into the pocket at y 87-94 (7.8-13.8 m wide): shop row without canopy.
